description: [Approved mode — test send] Sends a real test push to the app’s TEST DEVICES only (never to a real audience). If `subscription_ids` is given, all must be test devices. The API key needs the `mcp:write` scope; get explicit approval from the user before calling it.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

subscription_ids.description: Specific test devices (empty means all test devices).

name: send_test_notification
title: Send test notification
